title: Fourth-power lifting with singular-ideal control before desingularization
statement: Let R be Noetherian, A and Λ be R-algebras, A finitely presented, and π in R with Ann(π)=Ann(π²) in R and Λ. Let C be finitely presented over R/(π⁸), with R/(π⁸)-algebra maps A/π⁸A → C → Λ/π⁸Λ whose composite is induced by α : A → Λ. There exists a finitely presented R-algebra D (in universe max(u,z)) and δ : D → Λ such that (1) an R-algebra map A/π⁴A → D/π⁴D is compatible with α and δ modulo π⁴, (2) the image of π belongs to H_{D/R} (def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal), and (3) the ideal generated by τ(H_{C/(R/π⁸R)}) is contained in the image of the radical of H_{D/R}Λ modulo π⁸. No strictly standard assumption is needed.

source.place: Lemma 07CP as applied in Lemma 07F0, lines 1883--1893

proof.text: Induct using Ann(π)=Ann(π²) to obtain Ann(π⁴)=Ann(π⁸), in R and Λ. Apply 07CP with π⁴ and τ to obtain finitely presented D, δ and ρ : C → D/π⁴D with the commuting reductions and smoothness off π and over the smooth locus of C. The algebra R → C is the composite through R/(π⁸).
Compose A → A/π⁸A → C with ρ. It kills π⁴; the quotient universal property gives φ : A/π⁴A → D/π⁴D. Commutativity and hfactor give the compatibility on representatives.
Every nonsmooth prime of D contains π by 07CP(b). The radical singular ideal has the nonsmooth zero locus, so the zero-locus/radical criterion implies π ∈ H_{D/R}.

Set J=δ(H_D)Λ. For every prime p containing J, π belongs to p. Reduction modulo π⁴ identifies the inverse image prime of C with that under τ modulo π⁸, by the commuting diagram. If this prime were smooth over R/(π⁸), 07CP(c) would imply δ⁻¹(p) is smooth over R, contradicting H_D ⊆ δ⁻¹(p). Thus H_C maps into p/π⁸Λ. Every lift of τ(H_C) is in every prime containing J, hence in √J. The quotient image of √J is an ideal, giving the asserted ideal inclusion.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 07CP with π⁴ and the omitted verification of Lemma 07F0, written out from 07CP(b),(c) and the radical criterion; checked against https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07F0

theorem popescu_lifting_witness
    (R : Type u) (A : Type v) (Λ : Type w)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing A] [CommRing Λ]
    [Algebra R A] [Algebra R Λ] [IsNoetherianRing R]
    (π : R)
    (hAnnR : Module.annihilator R (Ideal.span ({π} : Set R)) =
      Module.annihilator R (Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)))
    (hAnnΛ : Module.annihilator Λ (Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Λ π} : Set Λ)) =
      Module.annihilator Λ (Ideal.span ({(algebraMap R Λ π) ^ 2} : Set Λ)))
    (α : A →ₐ[R] Λ) [FinitePresentation R A]
    (C : Type z) [CommRing C]
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 8} : Set R)) C]
    [FinitePresentation (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 8} : Set R)) C]
    (σ : (A ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R A) (Ideal.span ({π ^ 8} : Set R)))
      →ₐ[R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 8} : Set R)] C)
    (τ : C →ₐ[R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 8} : Set R)]
      (Λ ⧸ Ideal.map (algebraMap R Λ) (Ideal.span ({π ^ 8} : Set R))))
    (hfactor : ∀ a : A,
      τ (σ (Ideal.Quotient.mk
        (Ideal.map (algebraMap R A) (Ideal.span ({π ^ 8} : Set R))) a)) =
        Ideal.Quotient.mk
          (Ideal.map (algebraMap R Λ) (Ideal.span ({π ^ 8} : Set R))) (α a)) :
    ∃ (D : Type (max u z)) (_ : CommRing D) (_ : Algebra R D),
      FinitePresentation R D ∧ ∃ (δ : D →ₐ[R] Λ),
        (∃ φ : (A ⧸ Ideal.span {(algebraMap R A π) ^ 4}) →ₐ[R]
            (D ⧸ Ideal.span {(algebraMap R D π) ^ 4}),
          ∀ (a : A) (d : D),
            φ (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ d →
            Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(algebraMap R Λ π) ^ 4}) (α a) =
              Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {(algebraMap R Λ π) ^ 4}) (δ d)) ∧
        algebraMap R D π ∈ singularIdeal R D ∧
        Ideal.map τ.toRingHom (singularIdeal (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 8} : Set R)) C) ≤
          Ideal.map
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.map (algebraMap R Λ) (Ideal.span ({π ^ 8} : Set R))))
            (Ideal.map δ.toRingHom (singularIdeal R D)).radical
